overall_explanation: The completion path now examines every expected legacy worker. When any legacy worker has no recorded apply status, it marks only those pending workers blocked and returns before verifier startup; previously applied siblings retain their status and metadata regardless of ordering. If a legacy worker has a recorded non-applied status, verifier progress remains blocked. The added regression cases cover both mixed sibling orderings through finalizeInterruptedSubagentRun. Tests were not run, as requested.
